subject: District Capital Planning Process
overview: The Strategic and Capital Planning Subcommittee met to re-establish an annual capital planning framework and review district facility needs. The subcommittee voted to present a drafted capital planning policy to the full School Committee.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Agenda
items.summary: Chair Jenny Graham called the meeting to order and outlined the subcommittee's charge to update the district's capital needs document and establish an annual planning timeline.

items.title: Capital Planning Process and Operations Hero System
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed restoring school district oversight of capital planning by utilizing the Operations Hero ticketing system to categorize maintenance needs and schedule annual reviews.

items.title: DESE Net School Spending Thresholds
items.summary: Gerry McCue explained Department of Elementary and Secondary Education rules, noting that capital projects exceeding $150,000 per school are excluded from net school spending calculations.

items.title: Review of District Capital Projects
items.summary: Subcommittee members reviewed historical capital planning lists to verify completed building upgrades and identify outstanding facilities projects.

items.title: Capital Planning Policy Draft
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion to present a drafted capital planning process to the full School Committee, with Paul Ruseau assigned to write the proposal.

items.title: McGlynn Playground Update
items.summary: Dr. Peter Cushing reported that construction on the McGlynn Universally Accessible Playground was approximately 50 percent complete.
